title: Coverage profile
description: Which standards apply. Coverage adds; it never subtracts (GOVERNANCE.md R13).

extends.description: Coverage profile this one builds on. Cumulative, never subtractive.

standards.description: Standard IDs added by this profile beyond what it extends.

mandatory_emphasis.description: Already-selected standards this profile marks as load-bearing at its scale.

triggers_that_expand_this_profile.description: Observable conditions that expand coverage. Triggers only ever add.
